entries.question: The exact services extra (spec-kitty-services==<cli version>) makes uv lock unsatisfiable because the companion of that version is never on PyPI at release-commit time. Keep the extra via a uv workspace member (packages/spec-kitty-services, [tool.uv.workspace] + [tool.uv.sources] workspace=true), or drop the extra and document a separate pip install?
